title: How large is the default gap?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the unit used for an effect-size comparison.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the unit used for an effect-size comparison affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines D, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the unit used for an effect-size comparison in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
